verdict.what_is_wrong: The `ttmem` workload in one container is experiencing sustained cgroup memory-limit pressure, most consistent with the soft-limit/slowdown face: reclaim and repeated disk reads are present, but no kill of PID 4463 was observed in the sampled fault slices.
